Read decoder buffering, complete-line recognition, frontend port substitution, raw passthrough and final flush; explained token confidentiality and formatting-only authority.

Reviewed all19 isolated fixture scenarios, including malformed inventory, open findings, regression downgrades, and alternative JavaScript export forms; assertions check actual failure/success, not quality scores.
